name: TopBuddy
author: wptopbuddy

sections.description:
TopBuddy is a modern WordPress notification bar plugin that lets you draw attention to important messages without cluttering your page. Use a visual builder with live preview to craft notification bars that match your brand. Whether you want to promote a sale, announce a new feature, share a cookie policy or welcome new visitors, TopBuddy gives you all the tools you need to deliver the right message at the right time.

Why choose TopBuddy?

  • Enhance discoverability: Announce promotions, product launches or updates in an eye‑catching way that visitors can’t miss.
  • Boost engagement: Add call‑to‑action buttons that encourage sign‑ups, downloads or purchases directly from the bar.
  • Guide user journeys: Direct visitors to key pages (store, blog, sign‑up forms) and improve navigation without taking up space in your layout.
  • Improve user experience: Use sticky bars so your announcement or navigation stays available while users scroll down long pages.

Key Features

🧱 Easy Visual Builder

  • Drag & drop interface: Create notification bars with a visual builder – simply drag components like icons, titles, messages, buttons or images into place.
  • Live preview: See your changes in real time so you can perfect your design before publishing.
  • Template library: Get started quickly with pre‑made templates designed for common scenarios such as promotions, welcome messages or announcements.
  • Built‑in components: Choose from multiple component types including icons, text, buttons and images. No coding required.

🎨 Customization & Styling

  • Full color control: Customize background, text and button colors to match your site’s branding.
  • Adjust sizes & spacing: Set sizes for any of the available components.
  • Font sizes: Font sizes are easily changeable by simply selecting from a list of predefined sizes.
  • Button styles: Choose between link‑style or button‑style call‑to‑action buttons, with separate hover state colors.
  • Icon library: Access a built‑in library of icons to enhance your message.
  • Responsive design: All bars are mobile‑friendly, ensuring they look great on desktops, tablets and phones.
  • Alignment and content size Change the alignment or maximum content width with ease.

⚙️ Display & Targeting Controls

  • Flexible positioning: Show bars at the top or bottom of your website and decide whether they are fixed or sticky on scroll.
  • Advanced display rules: Display bars site‑wide, on specific page types (posts, pages, custom post types) or target individual pages and taxonomies using an AJAX‑powered search.
  • User targeting: Show different bars based on user roles (administrator, editor, subscriber, etc.) or login status (logged in, logged out or both).
  • Multiple bars: Manage multiple notification bars from a single dashboard.

📣 User Interaction

  • Call‑to‑action buttons: Add buttons that link to any URL or trigger actions (e.g., opening a form or modal).
  • Dismiss & recall: Include a close button so visitors can hide the bar, with options to disable the button.
  • Cookie dismissal: Remember visitors’ choices and configure how long a dismissed bar stays hidden before it reappears.

Typical Use Cases

TopBuddy is versatile and can be used across websites of any size or niche. Here are a few examples:

  • Promotions and sales: Highlight discount codes or time‑sensitive offers to boost conversions.
  • Welcome messages: Greet new visitors with a friendly note or a link to your most popular content.
  • Important announcements: Notify users about product updates, policy changes, maintenance windows or new features.
  • Cookie notices and compliance: Inform visitors of cookie usage or privacy policy requirements without disruptive pop‑ups.
  • Lead generation: Combine notification bars with subscription or contact forms to capture email leads.
  • Navigation aid: Use sticky bars to keep primary navigation or “back to top” buttons within reach.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “TopBuddy” and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin after installation.
  4. Navigate to Settings > TopBuddy to create your first notification bar.
sections.faq:
How do I create a notification bar?

After activating TopBuddy, go to Settings > TopBuddy in your WordPress dashboard. Choose a template or start from scratch, then use the drag‑and‑drop builder to add components like icons, titles, messages, buttons or images. Configure the display rules and publish.

Can I show the bar only on specific pages or for specific users?

Yes. TopBuddy’s advanced display rules let you target notification bars to specific posts, pages, custom post types or taxonomies. You can also target by user role (administrator, editor, subscriber, etc.) and login status (logged in, logged out or both).

Does TopBuddy work with my theme or page builder?

TopBuddy is theme‑agnostic and works with all modern WordPress themes. It’s also compatible with popular page builders such as Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, WPBakery, Beaver Builder and others. Because the builder uses standard CSS selectors, you can make any element sticky—headers, menus or announcement bars—regardless of your theme or builder.

Will my notification bars be responsive?

Yes. All bars you create with TopBuddy are fully responsive.

Does the plugin support cookies and dismissal?

TopBuddy uses a cookie‑based dismissal system. You can allow visitors to close the bar and decide how long the bar stays hidden before it reappears. You can also remove the close button entirely.

Is TopBuddy translation ready?

The plugin is translation‑ready and works with multilingual plugins like WPML, Polylang or Loco Translate. All text strings can be localized to reach a global audience.

Where can I get support?

If you encounter issues or have feature requests, visit the Support tab on the plugin’s WordPress.org page or contact us via our website. We answer support tickets as quickly as possible.
